Improved:


- Repeat tasks every 7 or 8 weeks


: The recurrence interval used to stop at six weeks; now you can go further out.
- Pasting links from more tools now creates real linked tasks


. Paste a Todoist, Trello, Notion, GitHub, or Linear link (17 services in total) via MCP and you'll get a fully linked task with preview and deep link, same as pasting it directly in the app, not just a plain URL.
- Agents can rename and delete channels


. Sunsama's MCP server now supports channel management directly.
- Emails linked via MCP now load correctly for everyone


. Tasks an AI agent links to an Outlook email no longer show "(Private message)" to the mailbox owner, and agents can now resolve a plain email address to the right account automatically.


Fixed:


- Fixed a bug where an unrecognized Google Calendar permission could freeze your whole workspace on a loading spinner.
- Cleaned up confusing tooltip wording on the built-in Sunsama calendar's "Enable" toggle, it was implying something the user hadn't actually chosen.
